entry.title: New: dsh-task-worktree
entry.summary: Complete task-scoped git worktrees: per-repo manifest for durable state, worktree-<name> branches, bring-back to main or direct commit, optional carry-over of uncommitted main changes (modeled on Qoder / Codex / Claude Code). Exact install spec: dsh-task-worktree. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
